newsitem.title: USA: Lafayette plans to buy Consolidated unit.
newsitem.headline: Lafayette plans to buy Consolidated unit.

text.p: Lafayette Industries Inc said on Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to buy New-York based SES holdings Inc, through a stock swap.

SES is a unit of Consolidated Technology Group Ltd which owns several high-tech manufacturing companies, including one that designs and makes bill-paying kiosks and consumer-interactive vending machines.
Lafayette was acquiring SES through a stock swap with SES's parent, SIS Capital Corp.
After the acquisition, SIS Capital would become the majority stockholder of Lafayette, holding a combination of common and convertible preferred stock.
SIS would also have an option to buy for a nominal consideration up to 15 percent of any SES companies under certain conditions, like sale or merger of these companies.
